title: Cover Palette
description: A full now-playing screen that takes its whole look from the record on it. The ground, the type, the play button, the progress bar and every shadow are pulled from the cover, and nothing names a colour. Skip a track and the sleeve breaks down into a coarse mosaic, swaps at its blockiest, and resolves block by block into the next cover while the whole page steps through to the new record's colours with it. Play, seek, skip, like, or jump straight to a song in Up Next.
intent: Colour you feel rather than read: a player that re-dresses itself from the artwork, where a change of record is one pixelated resolve, cover and theme stepping together, instead of a palette being reported.
